Alex (Security): Heads-up — Legal just asked for a triage packet for the vuln we escalated. They want raw auth/logging events preserved for potential investigatory hold. Our default retention is 30d. Do we have a safe short-term plan to extend only the affected buckets/streams for ~180d and give read-only access to a small set of folks?
Mira (SRE): we can snapshot the relevant indices and copy to a hold bucket with lifecycle = 365d, encrypted w/ CMK. timeboxed access via temporary role works.
Sam (Infra): agree. Need to be careful with SIEM exports — partner exports are push-only and use the export-service principal. We should not widen that principal. Better: create a dedicated export job that writes into the hold bucket with a narrow filter.
Alex (Security): @Mira can you outline commands/playbook so I can hand this to oncall? Jess from Legal also needs an ID for the hold.
Jess (Legal): If you're preserving data for investigation, we need LegalHold-2026-07-08 as the tag. Keep chain-of-custody notes. Also redact or flag PII; Legal won't accept unredacted creds.
Mira (SRE): short checklist: 1) create s3://redwood-hold/legalhold-LegalHold-2026-07-08 (kms CMK: arn:aws:kms:...:key/hold-cmk) 2) run splunk export or superset query export for index range 3) write to hold bucket 
Example commands:
```
# splunk -> s3 export (example)
splunk search "index=auth OR index=proxy earliest=1620000000 latest=1620086400" | splunk export s3 --bucket redwood-hold --prefix LegalHold-2026-07-08/ --format ndjson
# or, for raw traces
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-raw-logs/2026/07/08/ s3://redwood-hold/LegalHold-2026-07-08/ --recursive --profile infra
```
Mira (SRE): after copy, set object lock (governance) and attach metadata: legal_hold_id=LegalHold-2026-07-08, origin=incident-1342, scrub_policy=redact-credentials.
Sam (Infra): For KMS, we should avoid giving the legal team direct decrypt. Instead: create a KMS grant for the hold-validator role for Describe/Decrypt limited to the hold CMK, and set grant to auto-expire 180d. If Legal needs extracts, we can produce pre-scrubbed exports.
Alex (Security): Who owns the RBAC change to grant ephemeral read? I can open PR but need the exact role name and scope.
Mira (SRE): propose role: role/ephemeral_legal_hold_reader/LegalHold-2026-07-08 policy scope -> s3:GetObject on redwood-hold/LegalHold-2026-07-08/* plus CloudTrail logs.ReadOnly. TTL = 180 days.
Sam (Infra): I'll prepare terraform snippet and a short-lived service-account with credential rotation. Use STS AssumeRole with external_id=incident-1342.
Alex (Security): Also want SIEM export lock-down: only allow writes to the hold bucket from export-job principal, deny any s3:DeleteObject for everyone except infra-admins.
Jess (Legal): That sounds fine. Legal will review the redaction step before release. If we can provide a digest (hashes) + manifest, that'll help chain-of-custody.
DevSecBot: [automated] playbook referenced: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/log-preservation. Steps: create_hold_bucket -> export -> set_object_lock -> attach_custody_manifest.
Alex (Security): OK action items: @Sam start TF + role with TTL, @Mira run export + set object lock and add metadata, @Jess Legal will confirm redaction policy. I'll create ticket SEC-1342 and assign. 
Mira (SRE): quick Q — for SIEM exports we sometimes have PII in query_params. Recommend an extra scrub pipeline job that runs on the hold bucket and writes scrubbed copies under /scrubbed/. Anyone object?
Jess (Legal): required. legal_ok once scrubbed copy + manifest exists.
Sam (Infra): no objections. implementing scrub as lambda job that runs after copy. We'll log scrub operations to the audit log.
Alex (Security): one more — audit logging: can we ensure that any AssumeRole for the ephemeral role emits an AuditEvent with reason=LegalHold-2026-07-08 and ticket=SEC-1342?
Mira (SRE): yes, we'll require session tags and configure CloudTrail eventFilter for these assume-role sessions.
Alex (Security): Great — thanks. I'll update ticket with this thread. :thumbsup:
DevSecBot: [automated] ticket created: SEC-1342, playbook runbook attached.
